data.title: 小鞠知花 · 卧室被单间的颤抖全心交托
data.description: 安静的卧室内，浅粉吊带睡衣滑落香肩。娇小幼嫩的身躯被你完全拥在怀中，知花紧紧咬着嘴唇，眼角满是幸福的泪水，用颤抖微弱的声音告白：“如果是温水同学的话……怎样……都可以哦。”
data.location: dim softly lit private bedroom with ruffled sheets
data.action: nestled on bed with off-shoulder camisole, trembling in partner embrace, tearful eyes looking up with absolute sweet submission and love
data.lighting: soft warm bedside nightlight casting gentle golden glow on pale skin
data.mood: trembling virginal surrender, profound emotional trust, breathless tender love
data.promptProse: On a soft bed with slipping pink camisole, petite Chika Komari clings to partner with tearful devoted eyes and breathless trembling kisses.
data.animaCaption: Chika Komari trembling with devoted tearful face in bed embrace.
